blogs.title: From 780GB to 48GB: How QLoRA Makes Giant LLM Fine-Tuning Affordable
blogs.description: A plain-English walkthrough of how QLoRA slashes memory needs to fine-tune 33B–65B models on a single GPU, what changes under the hood, and what this means for teams without massive clusters.

blogs.title: NormalFloat4 Explained: Why 4 Bits Can Act Like 16
blogs.description: Demystifies NF4 quantization with intuitive visuals and analogies. Covers why normal-distribution-aware bins matter, how NF4 differs from FP4/INT4, and why it preserves accuracy during fine-tuning.

blogs.title: Double Quantization Demystified: Squeezing Extra GBs Without Losing Accuracy
blogs.description: Explains how quantizing the quantization constants works, why it saves memory, and what the trade-offs are. Includes guidance on blocksizes and when to consider turning it on.

blogs.title: Paged Optimizers in Practice: Bye-Bye OOMs on Long Sequences
blogs.description: A practical guide to using NVIDIA Unified Memory with paged optimizers to avoid memory spikes. Covers when paging helps, how to configure it, expected speed impacts, and debugging tips.

blogs.title: QLoRA Hands-On: Fine-Tune a 33B Model in a Day on a Single 24GB GPU
blogs.description: Step-by-step tutorial using open-source tooling to fine-tune a 33B model with QLoRA. Includes environment setup, key hyperparameters, data prep, cost/time estimates, and common pitfalls.

blogs.title: Data Quality Beats Data Quantity: Lessons from QLoRA’s Instruction Tuning
blogs.description: Revisits the finding that a small, high-quality dataset can outperform much larger ones for chatbot performance. Offers a checklist for curating datasets and suggests evaluation strategies.

blogs.title: Evaluating Chatbots is Hard: GPT-4 vs Humans, Elo vs 10-Point Scales
blogs.description: Breaks down why chatbot benchmarks disagree, how tournament-style Elo helps, and where automated evaluators like GPT-4 align or diverge from human raters. Provides a practical evaluation playbook.

blogs.title: LoRA, QLoRA, and Friends: Picking the Right Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Method
blogs.description: Compares popular PEFT techniques for practitioners. Discusses memory footprints, training speed, accuracy trade-offs, and how QLoRA’s quantized base plus adapters changes the decision tree.

blogs.title: Edge-Ready AI: Running a 7B Chatbot in 5GB and What It Enables
blogs.description: Explores deployment of small Guanaco-style models on laptops and edge devices. Covers privacy benefits, latency, use cases, and a lightweight setup guide for enthusiasts and students.

blogs.title: Benchmark Mismatch: Why MMLU Success Doesn’t Guarantee a Great Chatbot
blogs.description: Explains why different datasets reward different skills and how to align training data with your actual goals. Offers a framework for choosing instruction-tuning data based on target outcomes.

blogs.title: Beyond Language: Could QLoRA Work for Vision and Multimodal Models?
blogs.description: Speculates on applying the QLoRA recipe—low-bit quantization plus adapters—to vision transformers and multimodal systems. Outlines potential hurdles and experiments for researchers and students.

blogs.title: The Road to 3-Bit and Beyond: What’s Next After QLoRA?
blogs.description: Looks ahead at even more aggressive compression (e.g., 3-bit GPTQ + adapters), smarter data selection, and better evaluators. Maps research directions for the community to push costs lower still.
